name: Hero Sprint
description: Aimed for the fast, heroic run-and-gun stage feel: minor key at 168, galloping saw bass, square-wave lead and a constant arp on top. Should feel like sprinting while shooting. Risk: the lead may be too busy to hum.
intent: a fast, heroic run-and-gun stage theme

name: Overworld Stroll
description: A bouncy adventure-map march: mixolydian (major with a flat 7th for that open, wandering sound), snare march pattern, walking bass and a chirpy square lead. Wanted optimism with a hint of mischief.
intent: a bouncy adventure overworld march

name: Cathedral Run
description: Gothic castle chase: harmonic minor, 140 bpm, galloping bass and a saw lead that wants to sound dramatic. The raised 7th is where the drama lives. Meant to be relentless without being frantic.
intent: a gothic castle theme, relentless and dramatic

name: Spinning Blocks
description: Folk-flavored puzzle loop: minor, brisk and march-like, a plucky melody that circles and keeps going. I wanted something you could listen to for an hour without tiring of it. Dense melody, no arp.
intent: a spinning, folk-flavored puzzle loop that keeps going

name: Coastline
description: Breezy seaside drive: lydian (major with a raised 4th, which sounds like sunshine), a steady backbeat, octave-bouncing bass and a bright saw lead with a plucked arp. Aiming for windows-down optimism.
intent: a breezy coastal-drive loop with a bright lead

name: Hearth and Home
description: A safe village theme: major, slow 84 bpm, soft rim-click drums, walking sub bass and a flute-like lead. Wanted warmth and low stakes, a place to catch your breath between harder stages.
intent: a warm village theme for a safe place

name: Backroom Bazaar
description: A relaxed, jazzy shop loop: dorian, a light funk groove, walking bass and a plucked lead with bell accents. The goal is a cool, unbothered mood while you spend your hard-won coins.
intent: a relaxed, jazzy shop loop

name: Last Throne
description: Final-boss dread and speed: phrygian (the flat 2nd makes it menacing), 160 bpm, galloping saw bass, big saw lead and a square arp. Meant to feel like the room is closing in. Risk: too heavy for long listening.
intent: a final-boss loop: dark, fast and heavy

name: Press Start
description: A bold, hopeful title-screen theme: major, mid tempo, solid backbeat, a square or bell lead. It should sound like the start of something. The simplest, most direct tune in the batch on purpose.
intent: a bold, hopeful title-screen theme

name: Level Clear
description: A short, joyful victory loop: major, 132 bpm, a very busy square lead and octave bass. The point is pure celebration. Probably too short to loop well; I want to know if it still feels good.
intent: a short, joyful loop for a win screen

name: Glass Tide
description: Slow, glassy underwater level: lydian, 64 bpm, no drums, sub bass, bell lead and a constant bell arp like light moving through water. Aiming for floating calm with a little wonder.
intent: a slow, glassy underwater level

name: Something Listens
description: A sparse dungeon where something is listening: phrygian, 60 bpm, almost no drums, a lone flute-like lead with long gaps. Meant to be uneasy through silence rather than noise. Risk: may be too quiet to notice.
intent: a sparse dungeon crawl where something is listening

name: Hyperdrive
description: Space-shooter pulse: minor, 150 bpm, driving drums, steady eighth-note bass and a fast square arp climbing over it. Wanted momentum and a sense of speed, like a scrolling starfield.
intent: a space-shooter loop with a steady pulse and a high arp

name: Neon Groove
description: Funk stage with a groove: dorian, 110 bpm, syncopated bass, funk drums and a gritty saw lead. Aiming for a head-nod that still feels like a game level, not a band. The bass is the star.
intent: a funky, syncopated stage theme

name: Hold Forward
description: Bright speed-run tune: major, 168 bpm, backbeat drums, octave bass and a fast square lead. It should make you want to keep the stick pushed forward. The fastest major-key track here.
intent: a bright, fast loop that wants you to hold forward

name: Turn Order
description: A driving turn-based battle theme: minor, 152 bpm, octave bass, big saw lead and plucked arp. Aiming for epic, with a melody that feels like a hero's phrase. Two eight-bar halves with a changed ending.
intent: a driving turn-based battle theme with a big lead

name: Last Light
description: A slow farewell for the end of a long adventure: minor, 64 bpm, no drums, whole-note bass and a lone flute-like melody with a bell arp. Wanted wistful, not sad. A quiet end-credits feel.
intent: a slow farewell for the end of a long adventure

name: Echo Cavern
description: A curious cave-exploration loop: dorian, 78 bpm, sparse drums, walking bass, bell melody and a plucked arp that sounds like dripping echo. Mysterious but friendly, like you expect treasure.
intent: a curious, echoing cave-exploration loop

name: Panic Arcade
description: A frantic arcade chase: harmonic minor, 176 bpm, driving drums, relentless eighth-note bass and a square lead with a fast arp. Meant to spike your heart rate. The fastest and shortest-looping tune in the batch.
intent: a frantic arcade chase that speeds your pulse

name: Cloud Drift
description: A floating, dreamy sky stage: mixolydian, 92 bpm, half-time drums, sub bass, a flute-like lead and a rolling plucked arp. Aiming for weightless and open, the opposite of the chase tracks.
intent: a floating, dreamy sky stage
